label: States & Provinces
blurb: Fill in the map: all 50 states, the Lower 48 by road, the Original 13, and Canada's provinces and territories.

fields.id: stable slug, name + country (never changes once sent)
fields.title: the name in English; other names of the place itself go in aka (never state names or codes)
fields.state: the subdivision code within its country (NH, BC): what a map fills in by
fields.country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the country it's in (identity): US, CA
fields.year: the year it became a state (the Original 13: ratified the Constitution) or joined Canada
fields.aka: other names a task might use
